Criteria for The selection of Training Providers
For providing training to Rural Masons Under PMAY-G
1. The Organization should be registered under Society Registration Act- 1860/ Indian Trust Act/Indian
Company Act etc. As applicable . And must be CSDCI registered.
2. The Organization should have and established office (HQ/Branch/Coordination) in the geographical area of
Jharkhand.
3. The Organization should have an audited statement of accounts for the last three consecutive Financial Year
(FY-2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26)
4. The Organization should have an annual average grant receipts/turnover for Rs. 100.00 Lakhs for the last
three consecutive years as per audited statement.
5. The Organization should not be black listed or debarred by any Govt. Departments or similar organizations.
(Self-declaration by Notary certificate to attach.)
6. The Agency should have a proven track record of at least three years’ experience in implementation of On-
site mason training.
7. The Agency should have a team of trainers & supervisors with relevant qualification & experience of
providing onsite mason training. CSDCI or NVCT certified as trainer.
8. Organization must have of training Supervisors with minimum experience of 3 years in performing similar
nature of work.
9. Status single entity legally registered under appropriate authority in India. Consortium or Joint Venture is not
allowed.
Required documents to be submitted by Applicant organization
a) Copy of Certificate of Incorporation/Registration.
b) Copy of PAN.
c) Copy of Service Tax Registration Certificate.
d) Copies of IT return for the last three financial years (FY-2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26)
e) General details of the Agency.
f) Financial details of the Agency long with all the supportive documents as applicable.
g) Power of Attorney in favour of the person signing the bid on behalf of the Agency.
h) List of completed assignments of similar nature (Past Experience Details) along with copies of contracts/work
orders from previous clients.
i) Undertaking for not have been black-listed by any Central/State Govt./Any other autonomous bodies during
the recent past as per.
Evaluation Process:
Quality Based Selection (QBS) method will be followed during the overall selection process. Based on the
evaluation of technical proposal, the technically qualified Organizations shall be ranked highest to lowest
Technical Score (ST) in accordance to the marks obtained during the technical evaluation stage.
The Organisations secured with the highest evaluated Score will be awarded with the contract observing due
procedure. During evaluation if the highest score is equal in between two firms, the highest technical score
Organisation shall be awarded, in case technical score is equal, the turnover shall be taken into consideration and
the highest turnover Organisation shall be taken into consideration.

Technical Presentation:
The qualified Organisations will have to make a presentation before the client. The presentation shall cover
details on the appreciation of the project, approach and methodology, proposed staff structure, work plan etc.
The objective of the presentation is to enable the client to evaluate the qualified Organisation regarding their
understanding and preparedness for the proposed assignment. Clarifications, if any, as required by client will also
discussed during the meeting. The detail schedule of the presentation will be intimated to the concerned
technically qualified Organisations well in advance, if required
Award of Contract:
District Authority will notify the successful Organization in writing by issuing a letter of Intent (Lol) for signing of
the Contract and promptly notify the all other Organization about the result of the selection process.
The successful Organizations will be asked to sign the contract after fulfilling all formalities within 15 days. Terms
of the contract shall be made except by written amendment signed by both the parties. The contract would be
valid for 12 months from the date of effectiveness of the contract and will be extended on mutual consent. Sub-
contracting is not allowed under this assignment
Objective of the assignment:
Objective of the training is to enhance the skill of rural semi- skilled mason to build and affordable appropriate,
healthy and sustainable house under PMAY-G
Proposed Methodology:
 On- site training to be conducted as per the Qualification pack provided by the MoRD and on State-
specific designs for Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojna – Gramin houses.
 Maximum weight age to be given to the beneficiary’s willingness, at the same time they are to be made
aware about health, hygiene & environmental aspects in the housing design.
 TPs have to assist block team during the screening of beneficiary out of the list of beneficiary of the
particular pocket. Screening of aspirants for trainings prior to initiation of the training.
 List of Trainees to be uploaded by TPs in the website of assessing body for certification process.
 TPs will submit weekly attendance sheet of the trainees to block office for the payment of compensatory
wages to them.
 TPs will assist Assessor during assessment.
Annexure-1
The agency should keep in mind that the following areas to be addressed at the time of training and EOI
should be submitted accordingly
i. Trainee should identify by name all the tools & apparatus used the construction of a building.

ii. Trainee should be able to do the laying out the house they will construct.
iii. Trainee should be able to ding the foundation with proper size & shape.
iv. Trainee should be to construct the plinth with sand layering, brick soling. Random rubble masonry, Brick
masonry.
v. Trainee should be able to understand the need of damp proofing & the method of DPC construction.
vi. Trainee should be able to construct brick wall with cement-sand mortar.
vii. Trainee should understand the benefit of pointing & do the pointing on wall properly.
viii. Trainee should understand the need of lintel construction with loft inside & shed outside, design of lintel
(proper thickness, Composition of mortar, design of TMT bar binding etc).
ix. Trainee should erect the scaffolding for higher elevation works for construction.
x. Trainee should know to do the shuttering, bar binding, compacting the RCC at Roof.
xi. Trainee should know to construct the IPS flooring
xii. Trainee should know to construct the toilet including the fitting of pan, P-Trap, Elbow etc.
xiii. Trainee should know the need of curing & duration of curing at all level.
Note:_The selection of training Providers will be completely done as per the procedural guideline
of Rural Development Government of Jharkhand.
